_meta.purpose: Ownership declaration: which always-loaded index each machine may WRITE.
_meta.why: ~/.claude/projects/ mixes your own indexes, byte-identical copies synced from another machine, and throwaway worktrees. Two writers on a synced file = sync-conflict = lost memory. Declared, never guessed.
_meta.adding_a_machine: key = MACHINE_KEY env / hostname -s. owns = list of dir-name globs, or "*" for everything except never/never_glob. An undeclared machine exits 3 loudly.

_never_why: Put here any project dir that is a SYNCED copy owned by another machine's tidy. Verify with a checksum: identical bytes in two project dirs = one file reachable by two paths, not two files.
_never_glob_why: Worktree projects are ephemeral (1-3 line indexes); tidying them burns a model call to fix nothing.

my-laptop.note: Single-machine setup: owns everything except never/never_glob.

my-desktop.note: Multi-machine setup: name only the indexes THIS machine writes.
